description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations related to node search functionality, including cron jobs, search ranking, and comment reindexing.

classes.name: NodeSearchHooks
classes.description: Drupal class implementing search-related hooks for the node module, including cron, ranking, and comment reindexing.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Calculates min and max creation times of nodes for search ranking purposes during cron runs.

methods.name: ranking
methods.description: Provides search ranking options including relevance, sticky, promote, and recent based on node creation date.

methods.name: nodeUpdate
methods.description: Reindexes a node for search when it is updated, if it is a default revision.

methods.name: commentInsert
methods.description: Reindexes the associated node when a comment is inserted.

methods.name: commentUpdate
methods.description: Reindexes the associated node when a comment is updated.

methods.name: commentDelete
methods.description: Reindexes the associated node when a comment is deleted.

methods.name: reindexNodeForSearch
methods.description: Marks a node for reindexing in the search index.
